-----Original Message-----
From: Lisa Monelli <info@myvilla.la> 
Sent: Tuesday, October 20, 2026 6:55 PM
To: hello@canyon-news.com
Subject: One thought after your insurance quote op-ed

 

Hi Canyon News team,

 

(Writing to the Canyon News newsroom rather than Vlad directly — we couldn't locate a direct contact. Feel free to forward if it's a better fit for them or the desk.)

 

Really enjoyed your op-ed. The image of a deal dying three weeks into escrow, not at inspection but at the insurance quote, is the sharpest framing of this crisis I have read lately.

 

A quick hello from our side: at My Villa, we bring European construction resilience and the Italian way of living to homes in Los Angeles, designed in exposed reinforced concrete, cemento a vista.

 

One thought your piece sparked: the insurability problem is partly a construction-culture problem. In Europe, building for resilience has been the default for generations, long before carriers made it a condition of the sale. That cultural gap feels like the real story underneath the quotes.

 

Would you be interested in receiving more material on what we are doing, or in a short call with our founder Paolo?

 

Best,

Lisa Monelli

My Villa Media Team

 <mailto:info@myvilla.la> info@myvilla.la · myvilla.la
